## Before requesting review

- [ ] Every commit is signed off — `git commit -s`, or `dco` fails
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Every claim on a changed page is backed by something a reader can check —
      a query that returns what the text says it returns, a link that resolves
- [ ] Code examples come from a compiled source, not typed into the page
      (see `AGENTS.md`)
